The name would have a profound impact in creating a sense of security and resilience among its bearers, inspiring them to protect their communities, families, and personal values.

He brings them out of the darkness into the light." The name represents a spiritual connection to the idea of Allah's protection and provision, offering its bearers a sense of comfort and faith in the power of Allah to shield them and guide them through life's challenges. The name is a constant reminder of Allah's presence and the ultimate protection He offers to His beloved servants.
